title: CORE-6998 · SHARED: banking cards all show the same crop of the background pattern
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-6998](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-6998)

## Verified 2026-08-24 — reproduces

The pattern IMAGE is correct (same 766x766 asset, byte-equivalent to live's, only re-encoded).
What diverges is the crop: it is drawn at natural size behind a ~263x171 tile, so each tile
shows one small window onto it — and the clone showed **the identical window on every tile**.

| | live | clone (before) |
|---|---|---|
| `background-position` per tile | different on all 8 | `50% -250px` on all 8 |

Measured headed at 1440 on `/package/all-inclusive-package/` vs `/all-inclusive-package`.

## Live's rule, from live's own bundle

Both live components — the homepage hero strip (`HeroBankCards`) and the partners grid
(`BankAdsGrid`) — compute it identically:

```js
backgroundPosition: Math.floor(80 * Math.random()) + 10 + "% -" + (Math.floor(291 * Math.random()) + 100) + "px"
```

so x in 10–89%, y in -100 to -390px. Confirmed against 48 sampled tiles (observed 13–85% /
-106 to -384px) and by reading the minified source in
`component---src-pages-index-tsx-*.js` and `9b5230922323ba2d94d220d73c79e7fd4119a418-*.js`.

## Fix

One shared helper, `src/utilities/bankPattern.ts`, used by BOTH blocks — which is what
"SHARED" means here. It keeps live's exact ranges but derives the offset from the tile index
instead of `Math.random()`: these are server components, so a random offset would be frozen
by the route cache anyway (no per-load variety to gain) while making every build render
differently and adding needless visual-QA churn. Multipliers are coprime with their moduli
(37/80, 101/291) so neighbouring tiles land far apart.

`LandingHero` was already varying its tiles, but over a narrower band than live
(x 25–79% vs live's 10–89%); it now uses the same helper, and its ad-hoc inline formula is gone.
acceptanceCriteria: Every banking-partner tile shows its own crop of the pattern — no two tiles identical, matching live.
Offsets stay inside live's ranges: x 10–89%, y -100 to -390px.
The homepage hero bank strip uses the same helper and the same ranges.
Pattern image, brand colours, blend mode, size and repeat are unchanged.
